sections.heading: Terms & Conditions

items.text: The work shall be carried out strictly in conformity with the CPWD General Specification of Electrical Works Part-I (Internal) 2023, and Part-II (External) 2023 for electrical works in force and the Indian Electricity Rule - 1956, as amended upto date.

All the materials, used by the contractor should be got approved from the Engineer-in-Charge or his authorized representative before installation. No payment will be made for any unapproved or sub-standard materials used on the work. Rejected materials should be removed from the site of work within 48 hours, by the contractor.
No T & P shall be issued by the department.

Any damage to the installation/ building during execution of work shall be made good by the contractor at his own cost. Repair work if any, should be done with proper cement and sand ratio and to be match with existing finish.

The rates quoted shall be inclusive of all taxes i.e GST but exclusive of ESI & EPF as it would be reimbursed only (As applicable and eligible) after submitted proper documents of their deposits & to the satisfaction of Engineer-in-charge.
The work shall be carried out in security zone area; hence necessary passes shall have to be arranged by the contractor within Three days award of work for the workers engaged by him.

Lowest Bidder shall submit Police verification of staff/labourers to be employed at site within Five days of the award of work, otherwise panelty of Rs. 500/- per day till submission of Police verification of labourers and start of work. Pending or under process police verification will not be accepted.
The electrical work shall be done strictly in close co-ordination with civil works. No claim for idle labour shall be entertained by the department.
The firm shall submit the type test report for cable & other materials along with all necessary documents like invoice etc. Earth wire to be connected with lugs & thimbles etc.
No item shall be installed having Country of Origin in China.

All termination of electrical cables for sizes higher than 4 Sq. mm shall have to be done with proper thimbles / reducer. Copper thimble / reducer shall be used for copper cable and aluminum ones for Al. cables. Nothing extra shall be paid by the department however end termination of power cables shall be paid extra.
Earth wire in the switch board/DB should be covered with green sleeve for which no extra payment will be made.
Nothing extra shall be paid on account of dismantling the wire, conduit, fittings, fans, DB's & Panel etc. and the same will be deposited to the JE's Store.
All the debris etc. shall be removed from the site of work daily.
Electricity & water shall be supplied by the department free of cost.
The site in much secured important heritage building, so all related bye laws are to be followed.
Normally execution will take place after office hours. & site for the work will be provided one by one.
The watch and ward of the materials installed will be the responsibility of the contractor till handing over to the department on completion of work.

Any accident at site during execution of work to be workman and to the third party shall be responsibility of the contractor and claim if any arises due to such accident shall be on the part of contractor and department shall not entertain any claim in this regard.
Work will be carried out in the occupied building hence labour wastage may be there and no claim in this regard from the contractor shall be entertain by the department.
The site will be provided as and when required.

In order to ensure genuineness of equipment/materials, copy of invoice of each equipment/materials, custom clearance paper in case of imported materials duly authenticated by bidder shall be invariably produce to engineer-in-charge.
The contractor shall submit warranty/ guarantee certificate issued by the manufacturer for 05 (Five) years from the date of completion of work.

The components of the installation shall be suitably designed so as to satisfactorily function under all conditions of operation. • The entire work of manufacture/fabrication, assembly and installation shall conform to sound engineering practice. • All equipment and material to be used in work shall be manufactured in factories of good repute having excellent track record of quality manufacturing, performance and proper after sales service. • All equipment and material to be used in work shall be brand new having its date of manufacturing not more than 6 month old from the date of delivery at site with manufacturer's certificates, warrantee cards, technical catalogues, instructions, manuals and wiring diagrams etc.
The following documents related to staff/ labour to be deployed at site within 03 days of issued of award letter, failing to submit the below mentioned documents penalty of Rs.1000/- shall be levied.

It is the responsibility of the contractor that the above documents should be submitted in the office of Assistant Engineer (E), immediately after the award of work, so that entry passes/ token permission can be obtained timely. After getting the entry passes/ token permission from the security officer the contractor should take over the site immediately.
The work must be completed within the stipulated time failing which a recovery for Rs.1000/- per day will be deducted from the contractor's bill.
The payment shall be made minimum amount upto 10 lakhs Or First & Final bill basis and as per subject to the availability of the funds.

The contractor shall be use any of the following makes (ISI marked) for use in the work as below after confirming the approval from the Engineer-in-charge as applicable: - a) MS Pipe: Jindal/Jindal Hissar/Tata/Prakash b) Hydrant Valve : New Age/Padmini/Lifeguard c) Butterfly Valve : Sant/Kirloskar/leader d) Sluice Valve : Kirloskar/Sant/Kartar e) NRV : Sant/Kirloskar/Leader f) Y Strainer : Kirloskar/Sant/Kartar g) RRL Hose Pipe : New Age/Padmini/Lifeguard h) First Aid Hose Reel : New Age/Padmini/Lifeguard i) : Life Guard/Padmini/New Age/Mild Steel/Valentino Hose Cabinet j) Signage : Life Guard/Padmini/New Age/Mild Steel/Valentino k) Fire Extinguishers : Ceasefire/ Safex/ Lifeguard/ Flameklog/ Omex/ Agni/ Padmini.

notes: Note :- Failing to submit the following documents, no running and final bill shall be paid to the contractor- M.A.S. Register, Site Order Book, Hindrance register, Attendance sheet of the staff deployed, proof of the payment to the staff, proof of the material procured i/c tax invoice, service report duly singed by JE/AE etc. and any other documents as asked by Engineer-In-Charge.

items.text: All hardware items such as screws, thimbles, connectors, earth/neutral terminals, wires etc. which are essentially required for completing any item as per specifications will be deemed to have been included in the item even when the same have not been specifically mentioned.

All hardware material such as nuts/ bolts/ screws/ washers etc. to be used in the work shall be zinc/cadmium plated iron. The galvanized boxes of modular switch/sockets etc. shall be of the same make as of switch/socket etc.
While laying conduit, suitable minimum number of junction boxes shall be left for pulling the wires. These shall be placed in such a way that the same do not remain noticeable.
Any conduit which is not be wired by the contractor shall be provided with GI fish wire for wiring by some other agency subsequently. Nothing extra shall be paid for the same.

Multi stranded FRLS PVC insulated copper conductor wires are to be used in the work. Termination of multi-stranded conductors shall be done using crimping type copper thimbles at both the ends. Nothing extra shall be paid for the same.
The contractor shall follow the shortest route for circuits, sub-main, point wiring etc.

The connections of switches, sensors, earthing conductors & interconnections cables shall be made by adequate rating thimbles of approved standard makes only and nothing extra on this account shall be paid.
Check nuts shall be provided while terminating the M.S. conduits in switch board boxes for which nothing extra shall be paid.
All distribution boards shall be marked with circuits controlling the rooms/area/SDB controlled.

Material to be used in the work shall be ISI marked. The makes of materials have been indicated in the list of acceptable makes. No other make will be acceptable. The material to be used in the work shall be got approved from the Engineer-in-charge before its use at site. The Engineer-in-charge shall reserve the right to instruct the contractor to remove the material which, in his opinion, is not as per specifications.

While deciding the size of switch boxes for light points/fan point, exhaust fan point items, extra two modules will be provided for each fan point for fixing of regulator(s) (fan regulator is to be provided under different item). Wherever extra modules are available, the same shall be provided with blanking plates without any extra cost.

Modular type switches/sockets/telephone outlets/TV sockets are to be provided wherever indicated in the items. The same shall be of only one make. The modular plates of switches, sockets, telephone & TV sockets etc. shall be in two parts i.e. plates with frames within quoted rates.

The building shall be provided with false ceiling in various areas. In order to avoid maintenance problem, the contractor will not provide any ceiling rose/connector/looping box etc. above the false ceiling. The point wiring in that case will be extended up to the fitting/fan etc. directly without provisions of any termination arrangement in between. The wire from the end point up Page 368 to the fixture shall be considered to be included in the point wiring. Nothing extra shall be paid for the same.

Wherever it is not possible to provide rigid conduits, flexible conduit pipe shall be provided for drawing/running the wires. However, such arrangement has to be kept to the barest minimum and only with the prior approval of Engineer-in-charge.
Earthing and all hidden items of work shall be carried out in the presence of the Engineer-in-charge or his authorized representative.
The fan box cover shall be made from 3mm thick phenolic laminated sheet as per CPWD specification.

The contractor shall provide only metallic junction boxes/looping boxes with cover of required sizes even in PVC conduiting and such boxes shall be measured as a part of conduit/wiring without any extra payment.

The metallic junction boxes & looping boxes shall be covered with approved makes of phenolic laminated sheet. For telephone, television & fire alarm system shall be provided at all the floors within scope of work without any extra cost as per requirement & layout approved by Engineer-in-charge.

Any accident at site during execution of work to be workman and to the third party shall be responsibility of the contractor and claim if any arises due to such accident shall be on the part of contractor and department shall not entertain any claim in this regard.

sections.heading: LIST OF DOCUMENTS FOR NON-CPWD REG. SPECIALIZED AGENCIES/MANUFACTURERS/OEM

items.text: Earnest Money Deposit:

Banker's Cheque of a Commercial Bank / Account Payee Demand Draft of a Commercial Bank / Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) of a Commercial Bank / Insurance Surety Bonds / Bank Guarantee including e- Bank Guarantee (for balance amount as prescribed) from a Commercial Bank against EMD.

Copy of EMD receipt [Form F]: Copy of receipt for deposition of original EMD to division office of any EE, CPWD. Scanned copy of original Bank Guarantee including e-Bank Guarantee of any commercial Bank against EMD. (Note :- EMD is required to deposit in the office of Executive Engineer (E), DED-101, CPWD, Gate No. 6, North Block, New Delhi who is inviting bid or Division office of any Executive Engineer, CPWD within the period of bid submission).

Certificate of financial turn over from Chartered Accountant (Form - "A"): Certificate of Financial Turnover including Profit / Loss duly audited by Charted Accountant for the last 3 financial years ending 31st March 2024, as per Form A.
Banker's Certificate / Net Worth Certificate (Form B/ B-1) Copy of Banker's Certificate or Net worth certificate (on the format prescribed in Form B or B1 as applicable).

Certificates of Work Experience as per Form C: Details of Eligible Similar Nature of Works Completed During the Last Seven Years Ending Previous Day of Last Day of Submission of Tenders. [List of eligible similar nature of works completed during the last seven years ending last day of month previous to the one in which bids are invited including extended date, if any, in Form - C. If private works shown in support of eligibility, then certified copy of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) certificate (Form 16A & 26A) shall be submitted along with experience certificate and the TDS amount shall tally with the actual amount of work done. Otherwise, the amount that tally with the TDS shall only be considered for eligibility.]
Work Experience certificate of Completed works mentioned in Form-C, certified by owner department (Form-G).
Project under execution as per Form C1.
Bidding capacity as per Form C3.
Affidavit: Affidavit for eligible similar works not having been executed on back-to-back basis (Form- H).

GST Registration GST Registration certificate AND/OR Undertaking (Form "M"): GST registration certificate of the state where the work is to executed, if already obtained by the bidder. If the bidder has not obtained GST registration as applicable, then in such a case the bidder shall upload the following undertaking with the bid document. "If work is awarded to me, I/We shall obtain registration certificate as applicable within one month from date of receipt of award letter or before payment of 1st R.A. bill whichever is earlier, falling which, I/We shall be responsible for any delay in payments which will be due towards me on account of the work executed and/ or for any action taken by CPWD or GST department in this regard".
PAN Card: Copy of the PAN of the Bidder.
Undertaking as per Annexure D1.
